title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities : 
 - Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) system. - Ensure all construction activities are carried out according to approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards. - Conduct regular site inspections and quality audits. - Monitor the quality of construction materials and workmanship. - Prepare and maintain Quality Assurance plans, Inspection Test Plans (ITP), checklists, and quality reports. - Identify quality issues, defects, and non-conformities and ensure timely corrective actions. - Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Contractors, and other departments regarding quality-related matters. - Ensure proper documentation of inspection reports, test reports, NCRs, and corrective actions. - Monitor Aluform/Shuttering work quality and ensure compliance with technical specifications. - Conduct quality checks at different stages of construction work. - Ensure implementation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) related to quality. - Investigate recurring quality issues and implement preventive measures. - Train and guide site engineers and staff regarding quality standards and procedures. - Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and statutory requirements. - Prepare and submit periodic quality performance reports to management. - Participate in internal and external quality audits. 
 Preferred candidate profile : 
 - Strong knowledge of Quality Assurance and Quality Control processes. - Experience in construction and civil engineering projects. - Knowledge of Aluform / Aluminium Formwork systems will be preferred. - Good understanding of construction drawings and technical specifications. - Knowledge of concrete quality, reinforcement, shuttering, and finishing work. - Experience in conducting site inspections and quality audits. - Knowledge of NCR, CAPA, ITP, and quality documentation. - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. - Good leadership and team management abilities. - Excellent communication and coordination skills. - Proficiency in MS Office and reporting.

title: Site Executive Engineer
description:
WHO ARE WE? California Burrito is a fast-growing QSR chain with 2500+ employees across 140+ locations across Bengaluru, NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune. We started in 2012 with a simple belief: no compromise, just real ingredients.Since then, weve been serving honestly good Mexican food while building a more wholesome,sustainable way to do fast food, including growing our own fresh ingredients. Our mission is to become Indias most recognised name in Mexican cuisine while setting the standard for quality, speed and friendly hospitality. And how we get there matters just as much. We stay Open & Honest, Strive for Excellence, believe in Freedom with Ownership, andfocus on Growing Every Day. 
 THE OPPORTUNITY / ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a hands-on Site Executive to drive construction and design execution for our new stores. This is a site-based role for someone with a sharp eye for finishes who wont accept a wavy wall, a misaligned tile, or an off-spec laminate and who can work closely with vendors and contractors daily to deliver stores exactly as designed. 
 WHAT WILL YOU OWN? 
 Construction & Design Execution Execute store fit-outs as per approved GFC drawings civil, interiors, electrical, plumbing,HVAC, and kitchen installation. Ensure design intent is translated accurately on site: materials, finishes, colours, lighting, and detailing match the brand specification. Maintain high standards of workmanship inspect finishes (tiling, painting, carpentry,cladding, false ceiling) at every stage, not just at handover. Identify deviations from drawings early and resolve them with the architect / Project Manager before rework becomes costly. Lead snagging: prepare detailed snag lists and drive contractors to close them fully before handover. 
 Vendor & Contractor Management Work closely with contractors, fabricators, and material vendors on a daily basis align them on scope, quality benchmarks, and timelines. Conduct sample / mock-up approvals for key finishes before bulk execution. Track vendor deliverables, follow up on material deliveries, and resolve on-site coordination issues between agencies. Verify work measurements and contractor bills against BOQs. 
 Project Coordination Monitor daily site progress against the project schedule; report slippages and risks to the Project Manager. Maintain site documentation: progress photos, quality checklists, trackers and MIS. 
 WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED? 
 Youre self-driven and naturally take initiative. Youre comfortable figuring things out, takingchallenges head-on and owning what happens next.You think entrepreneurially, move with intent and dont need to be told every next step. You can bring people along, step up when something needs leadership and stay open to being challenged yourself. 
 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 
 Bachelors degree or diploma in Civil Engineering. 2-3 years of on-site execution experience in interior fit-outs QSR, retail, F&B, or hospitality preferred. Strong ability to read and execute from GFC, MEP, and detail drawings. Demonstrated eye for finish quality and detailing; knowledge of materials and finishing standards. Proven vendor / contractor handling negotiation, follow-up, and quality enforcement on site. Willingness to be on site full-time, travel across cities, and work to tight launch deadlines. 
 GET TO KNOW US BETTER Website: https://www.californiaburrito.in/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/californiaburrito_in Corporate Office: California Burrito Corporate Office, Sapota Park 1st Main Rd, 1st Cross Rd, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038

The Role at a Glance Be the local IT point of contact for the Lisbon office - onboarding, hardware, and everyday support. Learn and contribute to automation: Write and maintain simple scripts and Ansible playbooks under guidance to reduce repetitive manual work; progressively take on larger pieces of automation as your skills grow. Scripting: Working knowledge of at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or similar) and eagerness to write more of it. IT support mindset: Comfortable being hands-on with hardware and being the local face of IT - patient, clear communicator, good with people who arent technical. Cloud curiosity: Basic familiarity with a cloud platform (AWS preferred) and genuine interest in learning infrastructure and automation - formal production experience not required. Ownership and reliability: Able to work independently as the only (or one of very few) on-site technical resource, while staying closely connected to a distributed, remote-first team. Language: Fluent English (written and spoken); Portuguese is a plus for local vendor and office coordination. Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered. Nice to Have Exposure to configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef). Familiarity with Git and CI/CD concepts (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar). Coursework, certifications, or personal projects involving AWS (Cloud Practitioner or higher). Prior experience in a hardware/device support or IT helpdesk role.

title: Senior Maintenance Engineer
description:
Position Summary : The Maintenance Engineer is responsible for ensuring the efficient operation, maintenance, and reliability of plant machinery, equipment, and its utilities. The role includes planning preventive maintenance activities, troubleshooting equipment failures, supervising maintenance teams, improving equipment performance, and ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards. 
 Required Flexibility : Required to work in shifts or responding to emergency breakdowns during odd hours. Work environment may include working in factory, New project site, or facility layout modifications. Key Responsibilities : Maintenance Planning & Execution Plan and execute preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities. Ensure maximum availability and reliability of machinery and equipment. Analyze equipment breakdowns using Quality tools and implement corrective and preventive actions. Prioritizing the breakdowns and accordingly attending the same. Improve overall performance of the machines. Sound knowledge on TPM implementation and drive the TPM culture in the organization. Able to plan and delegate the responsibilities to technicians at times and ensure results are delivered. Review the spare parts inventory and ensure critical spare parts are defined and inventory is maintained. PLC programming added advantage Develop the trouble shooting catalogue for each of the production machines. Drive the continual improvements for the department, also drive compete projects. Optimization of layout for improved efficiency, cycle time of machines, using LEAN concepts. Develop skill matrix, identify the skill gaps for team and ensure required trainings are provided. 
 Troubleshooting & Technical Support : Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues. Lead troubleshooting activities during equipment breakdowns. Support root cause analysis (RCA) and failure analysis. Ensure quick restoration of equipment to minimize downtime. Assist in installation, commissioning, and testing of new equipment. Always meet the department KPIs like MTTR, MTBF and PM adherence. 
 Team Supervision : Supervise maintenance technicians and junior engineers. Allocate maintenance tasks and monitor work completion. Provide technical guidance and on-the-job training to maintenance staff. Ensure adherence to maintenance procedures and best practices. 
 Safety & Compliance : Ensure all maintenance activities comply with safety regulations and company standards. Conduct safety inspections and risk assessments. Ensure LOTO, safety standards including the PPEs are followed by team. Maintain proper maintenance documentation and reports. Ensure compliance with statutory and environmental regulations. 
 Spare Parts & Inventory Management : Monitor spare parts consumption and inventory levels. Coordinate with procurement for timely availability of spare parts and consumables. Evaluate vendors and maintenance service providers. 
 Continuous Improvement : Identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvement. Support TPM, Lean Manufacturing, and continuous improvement initiatives. Recommend equipment upgrades and process improvements. Participate in energy-saving and reliability improvement projects. 
 Required Qualifications : Bachelors degree / Diploma in, Electrical &Electtonics Engineering, or Mechatronics Engineering. Minimum 8–10 years of maintenance experience in manufacturing, industrial, or process industries. Experience in handling maintenance planning and troubleshooting activities. 
 Required Skills : Strong knowledge of industrial machinery and maintenance systems. Expertise in preventive and predictive maintenance techniques. Understanding of CNC Machine,PLCs, automation systems, and utility equipment. PLC Program and troubleshooting Hands of experience MES(Manufacturing Execution System ) Good analytical and problem-solving skills Why Why analysis, Fishbone diagram, DIMAIC Leadership and team coordination abilities. Familiarity with CMMS software Like SAP, Other local CMMS system, Power App. Knowledge of safety and quality standards. 
 Preferred Qualifications : Experience in TPM, Lean, Six Sigma, or Reliability Engineering. Certification in maintenance or safety management. Experience with SAP PM or similar maintenance systems. Good experience in SOP, SWI, ISO documents. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) : Equipment uptime and availability. Breakdown reduction and response time. Preventive maintenance compliance. Maintenance cost optimization. Safety performance and compliance. Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF). Mean Time To Repair (MTTR). 
 Working Conditions : May require shift work and emergency breakdown support. Work environment may include manufacturing plants, industrial facilities, or utilities. 
 Working Conditions: Experience in Power BI, Advance Excell, Power Point Preparation. CAD 2D. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of local language.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Machine operation and process 

 Day-to-day running of UV flatbed and cylindrical/rotary printing equipment Print parameter optimisation resolution, pass count, print speed, head height, curing settings balanced against throughput and quality Jig and fixture design for holding parts flat, square and repeatable; part-to-print registration Cylindrical printing specifically: chuck setup and alignment, rotation synchronisation, handling tapered and non-uniform bottle profiles, maintaining head gap over a curved surface White ink and varnish layer management, including build strategy and cure between layers 
 Maintenance and uptime 
 Own daily, weekly and monthly preventive maintenance and make it stick nozzle checks, capping station and wiper condition, purging routines, encoder strip and rail cleaning, filter and damper changes, waste ink management Printhead health as a first-order priority: nozzle deviation, clog prevention and recovery, alignment and calibration, and knowing when a head is genuinely finished versus recoverable Ink system management circulation, white ink settling, ink lines, degassing, filtration UV LED lamp condition and curing energy verification; identifying intensity degradation before it shows up as adhesion failure Diagnose and correct print defects banding, nozzle dropout, misregistration, orange peel, incomplete cure, colour variation Root-cause recurring failures rather than repeatedly fixing them. A defect that comes back monthly hasn't been solved 
 Substrate, adhesion and curing 
 Qualify new substrates: adhesion testing, primer selection, surface preparation and treatment Establish and document validated print recipes per substrate and per product Control environmental factors that quietly destroy quality dust, temperature, humidity, static 
 Colour and RIP interface 
 Manage RIP-side settings for the UV equipment and keep our machines in a calibrated state Work alongside our colour management specialist, who owns profile creation. You own machine condition; they own colour standards. Both of you are needed for output to be right, and the boundary should be treated as a collaboration rather than a handover 
 Spares, vendors and continuity 
 Build and maintain a critical spares list with realistic lead times, and hold what needs holding. Printheads and long-lead items are where a small stock decision prevents weeks of stoppage Manage OEM and dealer relationships, AMC contracts and service escalation; hold vendors to response commitments Maintain a downtime log with cause codes, and report honestly on what's actually costing us hours 
 People and documentation 
 Write SOPs an operator can follow without you present Train operators across shifts and verify they can actually do it, not just that they attended Deliberately transfer knowledge rather than accumulate it 
 What we're looking for 

 Must have 
 4+ years hands-on with UV inkjet printing equipment flatbed, cylindrical, or both Real printhead-level competence: maintenance, alignment, clog diagnosis and recovery. This is the single most important technical requirement Working knowledge of UV LED curing, ink chemistry behaviour, and adhesion on varied substrates Demonstrated preventive maintenance discipline you can describe a PM regime you built and sustained, not just one you were handed Systematic fault diagnosis. You isolate cause across machine, ink, substrate, environment and file rather than guessing RIP software familiarity — any of ONYX, Wasatch, Fiery, Caldera, ErgoSoft, or OEM RIPs such as RasterLink or VersaWorks Comfortable with mechanical and electrical maintenance at component level Able to train operators and write documentation in language they'll actually use Hindi and English 
 Good to have 

 Specific experience on Mimaki UJF or JFX, Roland LEF or VersaUV, Mutoh, Epson, or comparable Chinese-built UV flatbeds Rotary and cylindrical printing — bottles, tumblers, mugs, drinkware Experience as a service engineer with an OEM or machine dealer — see the note below, we rate this highly Printing on plastics, coated substrates and metals; primer and surface treatment experience Colour management fundamentals — linearisation, ink limiting, profile behaviour Jig and fixture design; basic CAD Screen printing, pad printing or sublimation exposure Maintenance data practice — OEE, MTBF, MTTR, downtime analysis A note on background: engineers who have worked for a UV machine OEM or dealer are strongly encouraged to apply. Servicing many machines across many customers builds a diagnostic range that's hard to acquire running one or two machines in one plant, and it's exactly the experience that prevents stoppages here.

title: Solution Architect - Full Stack
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Solution Architect with expertise in Node.js, React, Next.js, and Nest.js. The ideal candidate will be responsible for architecting scalable, secure, and high-performing cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure, with a focus on Azure Functions, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and system integrations. This role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams, translating business requirements into effective technical solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Solution Design and Architecture: Design and architect scalable and reliable cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure. Develop architecture blueprints, technical design documents, and implementation plans. Ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture standards and best practices. 
 2. Node.js, React, Next.js, and Nest.js Development: Lead and participate in the development of applications and services using Node.js, React, Next.js, and Nest.js. Optimize applications for maximum performance and scalability. Ensure code quality and maintainability through code reviews and adherence to coding standards. 
 3. Cloud Integration and Deployment: Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment and testing. Utilize Azure DevOps for source control, build, release management, and monitoring. Implement and manage Azure services such as Azure Functions, App Services, and more. 
 4. Database Management: Design and manage PostgreSQL databases to ensure high availability and performance. Implement and manage data indexing and search capabilities using Elasticsearch. Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance. 
 5. Security and Compliance: Ensure solutions adhere to security best practices and compliance requirements. Implement identity and access management solutions. 
 6. System Integrations: Design and implement integrations with third-party systems and services. Ensure seamless data flow and interoperability between different components. Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues. 
 7. Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements and provide technical guidance. Collaborate with development, operations, and other teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery. Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders effectively. 
 8. Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Monitor the performance and health of cloud-based applications and infrastructure. Troubleshoot and resolve performance issues and other technical challenges. Continuously improve and optimize cloud solutions for better performance and cost-efficiency. 
 Qualifications: 
 Experience Minimum of 10 years of experience in software development, with at least 2 -3 years in Node.js, React, Next.js, and Nest.js. Proven experience in designing and implementing solutions on Microsoft Azure. Strong experience with cloud architecture, PaaS and DevOps practices. 
 Technical Skills Proficiency in Node.js, React, Next.js, Nest.js, and JavaScript/TypeScript. Strong knowledge of Azure services (e.g., Azure Functions, App Services, etc.). Experience with PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch. Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform. Understanding of networking, security, and identity management in Azure. Experience with CI/CD tools and practices, especially Azure DevOps. 
 Soft Skills Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Detail-oriented and highly organized.

title: Senior Human Resource Manager
description:
Manager / Senior Manager HR Location : Bengaluru Function : Human Resources Reporting to : Sr. Vice President HR & Admin Travel :Periodic travel to Brigade Foundations schools, Skill Development unit and Indian Music Museum site 
 SUMMARY Looking for an experienced HR Manager / Senior Manager to serve as the dedicated HR anchor for our Foundation vertical, covering our schools, Skill Development unit and Indian Music Museum. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership across Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partnering, Employee Relations, HR processes and Statutory Compliance. 
 EDUCATION MBA / Postgraduate degree in Human Resources or a related discipline. 
 TECHNICAL SKILLS Strong HRBP and stakeholder-management skills Hands-on Talent Acquisition capability Good understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance Knowledge of Labour Codes, POSH and HR governance Strong documentation and audit-readiness orientation Ability to develop/revamp HR policies and processes Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Ability to work independently and manage diverse stakeholders Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability Comfortable working across education, skilling and cultural-institution environments 

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning : Own the end-to-end recruitment process for the Foundation vertical, including teaching and non-teaching staff, trainers/instructors, museum, education and operations roles; develop sector-specific talent pipelines through educational institutions, specialised job portals, professional networks, referrals and industry associations; partner with business/unit heads to understand manpower requirements and manage budgeted headcount and workforce planning; manage offer discussions, salary structuring, documentation and onboarding in line with Brigade’s HR frameworks; ensure timely closure of critical positions while maintaining quality of hire. 2. HR Business Partnering : Act as the single point of HR contact for school leadership, Skill Development teams and Indian Music Museum leadership; partner with stakeholders on employee relations, performance management, engagement, retention and workplace culture; understand the unique people requirements of teaching, training, administrative, curatorial and cultural-institution teams; support organisation design, role clarity and succession planning as the Foundation vertical expands; work closely with Central HR, Compensation & Benefits, L&D and HR Operations teams to ensure consistency with Brigade’s overall HR practices. 3. HR Process & Policy Development : Review, develop and strengthen HR processes and policies relevant to the Foundation vertical; identify gaps in existing HR practices and implement structured processes wherever required; adapt corporate HR frameworks to suit the specific requirements of schools, skill-development operations and cultural institutions; drive initiatives around employee engagement, retention and organisational effectiveness. 4. Statutory & Labour Law Compliance : Own and coordinate statutory and labour-law compliance across the Foundation entities and locations; ensure proper maintenance of statutory registers, records, licences, renewals and HR documentation; drive compliance readiness with applicable Labour Codes and other employment-related regulations; ensure alignment with Brigade’s processes relating to POSH, BGV, whistleblower mechanisms, disciplinary procedures and employee documentation; coordinate with legal/consulting partners and relevant authorities on establishment-specific regulatory requirements; ensure the vertical remains audit-ready and support internal/external audits whenever required. 5. Stakeholder Management : Build strong relationships with School Principals, educators, trainers, functional heads, museum leadership and senior management; serve as a trusted HR advisor and provide practical solutions to people- related challenges; balance business requirements with employee experience and organisational governance; work independently across geographically dispersed units and manage multiple priorities effectively. 
 CANDIDATE PROFILE - EXPERIENCE :- 10–15 years of progressive HR experience across Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partnering, Employee Relations, Statutory & Labour Compliance, and HR Process/Policy Management. Relevant experience in education, skill development, foundation/non-profit organisations or cultural institutions is essential. Experience managing HR across multiple locations/entities will be preferred. Candidates should have hands-on experience in managing recruitment rather than purely supervisory/strategic TA exposure.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION HR MANAGER / SENIOR HR EXECUTIVE 
 Department: Human Resources
 Position: HR Manager / Senior HR Executive
 Experience: 3-7 Years
 Industry: Real Estate / Construction / Infrastructure / Hospitality
 Reporting To: Senior Management
 Location: Corporate Office / Project Site
 1. Job Purpose 
To manage and coordinate day-to-day HR operations, recruitment, manpower planning, employee relations, attendance, payroll coordination, performance management, statutory compliance, and HR administration. The role will work closely with management and project teams to ensure effective manpower deployment and smooth HR operations.
 2. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Recruitment & Manpower Planning 
 Coordinate with department/project heads to understand manpower requirements. Prepare and maintain manpower plans and recruitment trackers. Source, screen, interview, and coordinate the selection of candidates. Coordinate offer letters, appointment letters, joining formalities, and onboarding. Maintain recruitment MIS and monitor vacancies until closure. B. HR Operations 
 Manage employee onboarding, transfers, confirmations, promotions, and exits. Maintain employee records, personal files, and HR databases. Ensure timely completion of HR documentation. Maintain employee master data and HRMS records. Implement HR policies and procedures effectively. C. Attendance & Payroll 
 Monitor daily attendance, leave, late coming, absenteeism, and overtime. Prepare and verify monthly payroll inputs. Coordinate with Finance/Payroll team for salary processing. Resolve employee queries related to attendance, leave, and payroll. Maintain accurate leave and attendance records. D. Employee Relations 
 Handle employee grievances and workplace concerns. Maintain effective communication between employees and management. Support disciplinary procedures and issue HR communications when required. Conduct employee counselling and facilitate conflict resolution. Promote a positive and professional work environment. E. Performance Management 
 Coordinate periodic performance appraisal processes. Follow up with department heads for performance evaluations. Maintain appraisal and performance records. Support management in promotions, increments, and employee development initiatives. F. Statutory Compliance 
 Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements. Coordinate PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Bonus, Gratuity, Labour Welfare Fund and other applicable compliances. Maintain statutory registers, records, and documentation. Coordinate with labour consultants and statutory authorities where required. Support internal and external HR/statutory audits. G. Training & Development 
 Identify training requirements in coordination with department heads. Prepare and maintain training calendars. Coordinate employee training and development programs. Maintain training records and evaluate training effectiveness. H. Project / Site HR 
 Coordinate manpower requirements for construction/project sites. Monitor site manpower deployment and attendance. Coordinate onboarding and documentation of project/site employees. Support contract labour documentation and statutory compliance. Coordinate with Project, Administration, Finance, and Site teams. Monitor employee welfare and site HR-related requirements. I. HR MIS & Reporting 
Prepare and submit regular HR reports covering:
 Employee headcount Manpower deployment Recruitment status New joiners Employee exits Attrition Attendance and absenteeism Leave Overtime Payroll inputs Training Employee grievances Statutory compliance J. Exit & Full & Final Settlement 
 Manage employee resignation and separation processes. Coordinate notice period and handover formalities. Conduct exit interviews. Coordinate clearance and full & final settlement with Finance. Ensure proper issuance of relieving and experience letters. 3. Required Qualifications 
 Graduate in any discipline. MBA / PG Diploma in Human Resources preferred. Additional certification in HR / Labour Laws will be an advantage. 4. Required Experience 
 57 years of relevant experience in Human Resources , preferably within:
 Real Estate Construction Infrastructure Hospitality Engineering / Project-based organizations 5. Required Skills 
 Strong knowledge of HR operations and processes. Recruitment and manpower planning. Employee relations and grievance handling. Attendance and payroll coordination. Labour law and statutory compliance knowledge. Strong MS Excel and HRMS skills. HR MIS and reporting. Good written and verbal communication. Strong interpersonal and coordination skills. Problem-solving and decision-making ability. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 AreaKPI RecruitmentTimely closure of approved positionsManpowerManpower availability as per requirementAttendanceAccurate and timely attendance managementPayrollAccurate and timely payroll inputsComplianceTimely statutory compliance with minimum deviationsEmployee RelationsTimely resolution of employee grievancesAttritionEffective monitoring and reduction of avoidable attritionDocumentationAccurate and updated employee recordsTrainingCompletion of planned training programsHR MISTimely and accurate HR reporting 7. Candidate Profile 
The ideal candidate should be a hands-on HR professional with 57 years of experience , capable of independently managing core HR operations and coordinating effectively with management, project teams, employees, consultants, and external agencies.
The candidate should demonstrate ownership, confidentiality, professionalism, strong communication, problem-solving ability, and the ability to work in a fast-paced project environment.

title: Non-IT Recruiter / Recruitment Specialist (CWR)(Contractual role)
description:
What youll do on a typical day: Manage the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening through offer closure and onboarding. Partner closely with hiring managers and business stakeholders to understand hiring requirements, priorities, and job specifications. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future hiring needs. Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, employee referrals, job portals, and other sourcing channels. Conduct candidate screening and assess candidates against role requirements and organizational fit. Manage candidate communication and engagement throughout the recruitment process to ensure positive candidate experience. Handle offer discussions, compensation negotiations, counteroffers, and joining follow-ups. Provide regular recruitment updates to hiring managers and stakeholders on pipeline, interview progress, offers, and closures. Maintain accurate recruitment data and ensure timely updates in SuccessFactors ATS/HR systems. Support volume hiring, recruitment drives, walk-in drives, employee referral programs, and other Talent Acquisition initiatives. Effectively manage multiple requisitions while ensuring quality and timely delivery against hiring timelines. 
 What you need to succeed at XPO: At a minimum, you’ll need: 4+ years of experience in Non-IT Recruitment / Talent Acquisition. Strong experience hiring for Finance and Accounting functions, particularly Finance Shared Services roles. Experience hiring for roles such as Collections, Cash Applications, Billing, Accounts Payable, OTC (Order-to-Cash), and related Finance operations. Experience in recruiting for HR, Operations, Customer Service, Corporate, and other non-technical functions. Strong experience in both volume hiring and niche business-function hiring. Proven experience working directly with hiring managers and business stakeholders. Strong sourcing skills across Naukri, LinkedIn, referrals, and other recruitment channels. Experience handling compensation discussions, offer negotiations, counter offers, and joining follow-ups. Ability to independently manage multiple requisitions and deliver candidates within agreed timelines. Strong communication, stakeholder management, candidate engagement, and interpersonal skills. 
 Be part of something big.

title: Government Tender & Business Development Executive / Manager
description:
Position : Government Tender & Business Development Executive / Manager Department: Business Development / Government Projects Industry: Education & IT Training Location: Pune Employment Type: Full-Time 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced and proactive Government Tender & Business Development Executive/Manager to identify, manage, and secure government tenders and projects related to Education, Skill Development, IT Training, Corporate Training, Digital Skills, and Workforce Development. The candidate will be responsible for the complete tender lifecycle, including identifying relevant opportunities, reviewing eligibility criteria, preparing documentation, coordinating with internal teams, submitting bids, and supporting the organisation through the tender and project execution process. 
 Key ResponsibilitiesTender Identification & Research 
 Search and identify relevant Government Tenders and RFP opportunities related to Education, Skill Development, IT Training, and Technology Training. Regularly monitor government tender portals and procurement platforms. Identify opportunities from Central Government, State Government, Universities, Government Institutions, Skill Development Bodies, and other public organisations. Analyse tender requirements, eligibility criteria, scope of work, and project requirements. 
 Tender Management 
 Manage the complete tendering and bidding process. Prepare and coordinate tender documents, technical proposals, commercial proposals, and supporting documentation. Ensure all tender submissions are completed within the required deadlines. Maintain proper records of submitted, ongoing, won, and lost tenders. Coordinate with internal departments for required documents and information. 
 Documentation & Compliance 
 Prepare and manage documents required for tender submissions. Ensure compliance with eligibility criteria and tender requirements. Coordinate for company documents, financial documents, technical documents, certificates, declarations, and other required information. Maintain an updated database of company credentials and documents required for government tenders. 
 Government & Business Development 
 Build relationships with relevant government departments, educational institutions, universities, and skill development organisations. Identify new government training and education business opportunities. Participate in pre-bid meetings and tender-related discussions when required. Coordinate with management and internal teams for proposal strategy and project planning. 
 Reporting 
 Maintain a regular pipeline of upcoming and active tender opportunities. Share regular reports on: New Tender Opportunities Submitted Tenders Upcoming Deadlines Tender Status Won and Lost Opportunities Potential Revenue 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Experience in Government Tender Management / Tendering / Government Business Development. Knowledge of government procurement processes and tender documentation. Experience in preparing technical and commercial proposals. Strong documentation and proposal-writing skills. Good understanding of the Education, Training, Skill Development, or IT sector. Ability to understand RFPs, RFQs, eligibility criteria, and scope of work. Strong communication, coordination, and negotiation skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and documentation. Ability to manage multiple tender deadlines. 
 Preferred Experience 
 Candidates with experience in the following areas will be preferred: Government Education Projects Skill Development Projects IT Training Projects Government Training Programs University Training Projects Digital Skill Development Corporate and Institutional Training 
 Experience 
 2-6+ years of relevant experience Candidates with proven experience in successfully managing and winning government tenders will be preferred. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Number of relevant tender opportunities identified Number of tenders submitted Tender submission accuracy and compliance Number and value of tenders won Revenue generated through government projects Development of new government and institutional partnerships Tender conversion ratio 
 Ideal Candidate 
 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in government tendering and business development, with the ability to identify opportunities and manage the complete tender process. 
 The candidate should also understand the Education and Training ecosystem and be capable of helping the organisation expand into Government, Skill Development, Institutional, and Public Sector training projects. If you have experience in Government Tenders and are passionate about building large-scale Education and Training opportunities, we would like to hear from you.

 Role Overview 
 The Business Development Executive will be responsible for identifying and engaging UK business owners, directors 
 and senior decision-makers through outbound telephone and email outreach. The role will focus on creating interest, 
 understanding basic business funding requirements, qualifying opportunities and arranging qualified meetings for the 
 UK-based funding team. The position is primarily a business development and opportunity-generation role; full training 
 will be provided on invoice finance and relevant funding solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 ¢ UK Outbound Business Development: Make structured outbound calls to UK businesses and speak professionally 
 with business owners, directors, finance directors and other senior decision-makers. Introduce AG Gen-X and establish 
 a relevant commercial conversation. 
 ¢ Lead Qualification: Understand the prospect's business profile, current funding arrangements and potential 
 requirements; ask effective discovery questions and identify businesses that may benefit from reviewing their existing 
 finance facilities. 
 ¢ Appointment Setting: Arrange qualified meetings or calls between suitable prospects and the UK-based funding team. 
 Ensure appointments are properly qualified and relevant information is captured before handover. 
 ¢ Email Outreach & Follow-Up: Send personalised, professional follow-up emails, maintain structured follow-up 
 schedules and consistently work warm prospects until they are converted, disqualified or otherwise closed. 
 ¢ Objection Handling: Handle common objections professionally, communicate value clearly, and demonstrate good 
 judgement regarding when to continue a conversation and when to move on. 
 ¢ CRM & Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, follow-ups, qualified prospects, 
 meetings and outcomes in the CRM. Ensure pipeline information remains current and complete. 
 ¢ Business Operations & Reporting: Track daily activity and provide regular reporting on calls, meaningful 
 conversations, qualified opportunities, meetings booked, follow-up activity and opportunities generated for the funding 
 team. 
 AG Gen-X ¢ Bespoke Solutions For Better World 
 Page 1 
 
 
 
 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 AG GEN-X ¢ UK MARKET 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 ¢ Outbound calls made and meaningful conversations achieved 
 ¢ UK business owners / decision-makers contacted 
 ¢ Qualified prospects generated 
 ¢ Meetings booked and meeting attendance 
 ¢ Follow-up activity and pipeline discipline 
 ¢ Quality and accuracy of CRM records 
 ¢ Opportunities generated for the UK funding team 
 What We Are Looking For 
 ¢ 13 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, lead generation, inside sales or telecalling. 
 ¢ Experience contacting UK businesses is highly desirable. 
 ¢ Excellent spoken English with a clear, confident and professional telephone manner. 
 ¢ Comfortable speaking with business owners, directors and senior decision-makers. 
 ¢ Strong email writing, listening, questioning and follow-up skills. 
 ¢ Confident making cold calls and handling rejection without losing professionalism. 
 ¢ Ability to conduct a genuine business conversation rather than simply reading from a script. 
 ¢ Commercially aware, organised, target-oriented and comfortable working with CRM systems. 
 Advantageous Experience 
 Experience in invoice finance, invoice discounting, factoring, asset-based lending, business loans, commercial 
 finance, banking, financial services, FinTech, B2B recruitment, UK lead generation or UK business development will 
 be an advantage. Finance experience is not essential. Full training will be provided on products, funding concepts 
 and the outreach process. 
 Product & Market Training 
 Selected candidates will be trained on the fundamentals of invoice finance, invoice discounting, factoring, asset 
 finance, business loans, working capital finance and other relevant UK business funding solutions. The role is focused 
 on business development and opportunity generation rather than providing regulated financial advice. 
 Working Hours 
 The role will operate around UK business hours from India. Candidates should be comfortable working UK-aligned 
 shifts, with timings adjusted where required for UK daylight-saving changes and business requirements. 
 What AG Gen-X Offers 
 ¢ Competitive fixed salary with performance-based incentives. 
 ¢ Structured training on UK business finance and invoice finance.

 ¢ Direct exposure to a UK-focused business development environment and UK-based funding team. 
 ¢ Career progression within international sales, business development and account management. 
 ¢ Opportunity to grow with a new international business vertical. 
 Ideal Candidate 
 The ideal candidate is confident, commercially minded, persistent and professional, with the ability to build rapport 
 quickly and speak naturally with UK business owners. A strong candidate should enjoy creating opportunities, asking 
 the right questions, handling objections and maintaining disciplined follow-up. 
 Selection Process 
 Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a communication assessment and a short role-play involving a cold 
 call to a UK business owner. The assessment will focus on call opening, rapport building, discovery questions,

title: Business Development Manager (Architects & Interior Designers)
description:
BRAQ is a premium tiles, slabs and sanitaryware brand under BR Ceramics, established in 1960. We operate experience centres across Delhi NCR Rajouri Garden, Mansarover Garden, Gurgaon (Golf Course Road) and a flagship opening shortly in Noida alongside a national distribution network of 500+ dealers. We are also an integrated Kohler partner across all our locations. 
 We are building a dedicated specification channel and are hiring three Business Development Managers, one for each cluster, to own the architect, interior designer and contractor relationship in their territory. 
 The Role This is a relationship-led specification sales role, not a walk-in or counter sales role. You will own one territory end to end and be the single point of contact for every architect, designer and contractor in it. 
 Key Responsibilities Build and own a working relationship base of architects, interior designers, contractors and turnkey firms in your assigned territory Get BRAQ products specified at the design stage of residential, villa, farmhouse and commercial projects Conduct regular in-person visits to design studios, architect offices and project sites this is a field role Bring architects and their clients into the experience centre for selections, and personally manage the selection experience Maintain a live project register track every project from specification through order to delivery Coordinate with the showroom and warehouse teams on samples, stock availability and timely delivery Administer the architect partner programme for your territory Report pipeline, conversion and revenue against target on a monthly basis 
 Who We Are Looking For 3–8 years in architect-facing or specification sales within building materials — tiles, sanitaryware, faucets, surfaces, lighting, modular kitchens, paints, flooring or similar An existing, active relationship base with architects, interior designers or contractors in Delhi NCR. Please specify in your application which micro-market your relationships are strongest in (e.g. Golf Course Road, Sohna Road, Noida sectors, West Delhi, Dwarka) Demonstrable track record of projects specified and closed — we will discuss specific projects in the interview Comfortable working independently in the field with ownership of a territory and a number Presentable, articulate, and credible in a design conversation. You should be able to hold your own with an architect on materials, finishes and application Fluent in English and Hindi Two-wheeler or four-wheeler with valid licence 
 Preferred Background Candidates currently or previously with premium tile, sanitaryware and surface brands — or with premium dealers and experience centres — will be prioritised. 
 What We Offer Fixed salary plus an uncapped incentive linked directly to specification revenue you generate Full ownership of a territory — you build it, you own it Access to an exclusive imported product portfolio not available across the market, plus a Kohler integrated offering A 65-year-old established brand with deep stock and a reputation for reliable delivery Direct reporting to leadership, with real influence over how the specification channel is built 
 How to Apply Apply through Naukri with your CV. In your application, please mention: (1) your strongest micro-market, (2) approximate number of architects and designers you actively work with, and (3) two projects you have specified and closed in the last 18 months.

 Department: Aftersales (Service, Parts, and Customer Relations)

 Job Purpose 
 The Vice President of Aftersales provides strategic vision, operational leadership, and financial oversight for the dealerships service, parts, collision repair, and customer care departments. As a key member of the executive leadership team, this role is fully responsible for maximizing aftersales profitability, improving fixed operations absorption rates, and embedding the core Toyota "Customer First" philosophy across all locations to drive lifetime owner retention. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic & Operational Leadership Direct the daily operations of multi-location Service and Parts departments to ensure peak efficiency, modern workflow throughput, and maximum technician efficiency. Oversee parts inventory management, utilizing retail inventory systems to balance high fill rates with efficient stock turnover. 2. Financial Performance & Profitability Take full profit and loss (P&L) accountability for all fixed operations, establishing annual revenue, gross profit, and expense budgets. Drive labor sales, parts sales, wholesale growth, and accessory penetration to exceed monthly and yearly financial benchmarks. Analyze daily operational metrics (e.g., effective labor rate, hours per repair order, parts matrix pricing) to implement corrective strategies when needed. 3. Toyota Guest Experience & Retention Champion the Toyota Customer First mindset, continuously tracking and improving the Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) and net promoter metrics. Develop proactive customer retention initiatives, service marketing campaigns, and digital booking strategies to secure long-term brand loyalty. Ensure professional, swift resolution of complex customer escalations, maintaining close communication with regional Toyota distributors. 4. Team Development & Compliance Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing team of Service Managers, Parts Managers, advisors, and technical personnel. Establish training paths to ensure technicians achieve and maintain required Toyota certifications. Enforce strict compliance with local governmental regulations, environmental standards, workplace safety protocols, and factory warranty policies. description:
Job Description Sales Executive Intern Company: Revolution Games Private Limited
 Location: Chennai
 Position: Sales Executive Intern Phone : 8754467895 
 Employment Type: Internship / Training Program About Revolution Games Revolution Games is a Chennai-based game development and esports company working across game development, esports, gaming platforms, AR/VR, AVGC, education, and technology solutions . We are looking for energetic and ambitious candidates who are interested in building a career in Sales, Business Development, Marketing, and Client Relationship Management . Role Overview The Sales Executive Intern will support the Sales and Business Development team in identifying new opportunities, generating leads, connecting with potential clients and partners, and promoting the companys products and services. The candidate will get practical exposure to B2B sales, institutional sales, corporate sales, partnerships, sponsorships, and business development . Key Responsibilities Identify and generate new business leads. Contact potential clients through calls, emails, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other channels. Introduce Revolution Games' products, services, and business solutions to prospective customers. Follow up with leads and maintain regular communication. Schedule meetings and product demonstrations for the sales team. Assist in preparing proposals, quotations, presentations, and sales documents. Maintain and update lead and customer databases. Support business development activities with colleges, universities, companies, event organizers, sponsors, and other organizations. Promote game development services, esports solutions, training programs, gaming products, and technology services. Conduct basic market and competitor research. Build and maintain positive relationships with customers and business partners. Participate in exhibitions, college events, esports tournaments, conferences, and promotional activities when required. Follow up on proposals and support the team in converting opportunities into business. Achieve assigned lead generation and sales targets. Required Skills Good communication and interpersonal skills. Confidence in speaking with customers and business representatives. Basic understanding of sales and marketing. Good presentation and negotiation skills. Ability to communicate through phone, email, and social media. Basic knowledge of MS Office / Google Workspace. Good organizational and follow-up skills. Willingness to learn and work toward targets. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Additional Skills Advantage Knowledge or experience in any of the following will be an added advantage: Digital Marketing Social Media Marketing LinkedIn Sales Lead Generation CRM Software Business Development Corporate Sales Institutional / College Sales Sponsorship Sales Event Marketing Gaming / Esports Industry IT / Software Sales Eligibility Students or fresh graduates from: BBA / MBA / B.Com / B.Sc / BCA / B.E / B.Tech / MCA / Mass Communication / Marketing / Sales / Business Management or any relevant discipline. Freshers with strong communication skills and an interest in sales are encouraged to apply. What You Will Learn During the internship, candidates will gain practical exposure to: Lead Generation B2B Sales Business Development Corporate Communication Client Relationship Management Sales Presentations Proposal Preparation Negotiation Follow-up Strategies Institutional Sales Sponsorship & Partnership Development CRM and Sales Pipeline Management Market Research Closing Sales Opportunities Internship Benefits Practical experience in real business development activities. Opportunity to work with live customers and business partners. Exposure to the Gaming, Esports, AVGC, AR/VR, and Technology industries. Mentoring from experienced professionals. Internship Certificate upon successful completion. Opportunity to participate in company events, exhibitions, and esports tournaments. Performance-based incentives may be provided based on company policy. Top-performing interns may be considered for permanent Sales / Business Development positions , depending on performance and available openings. Candidate Profile We are looking for candidates who are: Energetic and self-motivated. Confident communicators. Interested in sales and business development. Comfortable approaching and speaking with new people. Goal-oriented and willing to work toward targets. Good at maintaining professional relationships. Interested in the gaming, esports, technology, or education industries. Selection Process Resume Screening Communication Assessment Interview Internship Selection Training & Performance Evaluation Start your career in Sales and Business Development with Revolution Games and gain real industry experience in the fast-growing Gaming, Esports and Technology sector.

title: Servicer Sales Executive
description:
Services Sales Executive - India Software Development & Managed Engineering 12th Wonder Pune 12th Wonder has delivered custom software and managed engineering teams to 100+ Indian enterprises since 2012. The delivery engine is proven - 70 engineers, a Pune centre operational since 2019, and a client base that renews. What's missing is a dedicated hunter who can systematically connect this capability to new buyers. We're hiring a Services Sales Executive to own a territory, build pipeline from scratch, and close new-logo deals across India. The Role This is a pure selling role. No team to manage in year one. No SDR motion to build. Your job is to find enterprise buyers who need custom software development or managed engineering capacity, and close them. You'll spend 80%+ of your time in front of customers - identifying strategic accounts, building relationships with CXOs and engineering leaders, running discovery, shaping solutions with our pre-sales and delivery teams, writing proposals, negotiating contracts, and closing. The remaining time goes into pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and sharpening your territory plan. You own your territory and your number. You'll define target accounts within assigned segments, decide your outbound approach, and run your own pipeline cadence. You'll have a pre-sales engineer and delivery leadership behind you on every qualified opportunity - but the deal is yours to win or lose. Your buyer: India-domiciled enterprises across three primary segments - automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, testing and certification (TIC) labs, and enterprise engineering R&D centres. Rupee-denominated, relationship-led, CXO-level deals averaging ~ 20 lakh. Pune's position inside the Chakan-Talegaon supplier belt puts the densest cluster of target accounts within a mornings drive. What you're selling Two proven service lines, both with referenceable customers and repeatable delivery models: Custom software development. Full-stack engineering teams that design, build, and ship applications for enterprise clients - web, mobile, cloud, data, and integration. Engagements typically start as fixed-scope projects and expand into ongoing development partnerships. Managed engineering teams. Dedicated engineering capacity operated from our Pune centre, embedded in the clients product or platform roadmap. Longer-duration, higher-ACV engagements with sticky renewal economics. Clients retain technical control; we provide the team, the management layer, and the delivery infrastructure. Both service lines sell to the same buyers through the same motion. The typical land is a 15-25 lakh project engagement; the expand is a managed team at 3-5x the initial contract value. What you'll have behind you You're not selling a pitch deck. First proposals submitted. At least one deal in advanced negotiation. First 180 days - First closed-won deals on the board. Pipeline coverage at 3x forward target. At least one account in active expansion from project to managed team. description:
Deputy General Manager Digital Marketing Performance Marketing | Digital Growth | AI-First Search | Content Location: Bengaluru 
 Reporting To: Sr.VP & Business Head Experience: 7 to 12 years 
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About Deeksha Vedantu Deeksha Vedantu brings together Deekshas established academic strength and Vedantu’s digital learning capabilities to create an integrated learning ecosystem for students. As the organization continues to scale, digital is becoming an increasingly important engine for brand discovery, student acquisition, engagement and admissions. Role Purpose We are looking for a high-ownership, performance-oriented digital marketing professional to join us as Deputy General Manager – Digital Marketing. Reporting to the Head of Growth, the role will independently own the day-to-day digital marketing agenda across performance marketing, search, AI-led discovery, SEO, content, analytics and conversion optimisation. The role is designed for a strong digital operator who can translate business objectives into measurable campaigns, manage agencies and partners, work hands-on with platforms and data, and continuously improve the efficiency and quality of digital acquisition. Key Responsibilities 1. Performance Marketing & Digital Acquisition Own and execute performance marketing strategy across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube and other relevant digital channels. Manage Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Display, remarketing and lead-generation campaigns. Build full-funnel acquisition plans covering awareness, consideration, lead generation, counselling and admission. Optimise CPL, cost per qualified lead, CAC, lead-to-counselling conversion, counselling-to-admission conversion and ROAS/ROI. Develop campaign strategies by geography, class, course, examination, audience and intent. Continuously test new channels, formats, audiences, creatives and messaging. 2. AI-First Search, AEO & GEO Develop Deeksha Vedantu’s approach to the rapidly evolving AI Search and discovery ecosystem. Drive initiatives across Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and AI-search visibility. Improve discoverability across Google’s AI-led search experiences and relevant AI discovery platforms. Build strategies around conversational search, long-tail intent, topical authority, entities and structured content. Understand the questions and decision journeys of students and parents across traditional search and AI platforms. Create a measurable framework to track visibility, authority and referral opportunities from AI-led discovery. 3. SEO & Organic Growth Own the organic search strategy across Deeksha Vedantu’s websites and digital properties. Drive technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO, local SEO, internal linking, structured data and authority-building initiatives. Develop search-intent and keyword strategies aligned to courses, examinations, locations and student/parent needs. Increase organic traffic, search visibility and organic lead generation through a structured growth roadmap. 4. Content Marketing Own the digital content strategy in collaboration with academic, creative and content teams. Build content engines around JEE, NEET, CBSE/State Boards, Classes 11–12, careers, college choices and academic guidance. Develop content for reach, engagement, search, trust and conversion. Build a content ecosystem that works across Search, YouTube, Social, AI Search, Website and lead-generation funnels. Use search, audience and performance data to continuously refine content themes, formats and distribution. 5. Landing Pages & Conversion Optimisation Own the conversion journey beyond traffic acquisition. Improve landing pages, lead forms, CTAs, WhatsApp journeys, website conversion and mobile experience. Identify funnel drop-offs and develop hypotheses to improve conversion. Drive A/B testing of messaging, creatives, landing pages, offers and user journeys. 6. Analytics, Attribution & Performance Intelligence Build a robust digital measurement framework using GA4, advertising platforms, CRM and business data. Establish reliable source-to-lead and source-to-admission attribution. Develop dashboards covering leads, qualified leads, CAC, conversion, admissions, revenue contribution and ROI. Move optimisation beyond CPL towards qualified leads, admissions and revenue outcomes. Use data to identify incremental growth opportunities and improve digital budget allocation. 7. AI, Automation & Marketing Technology Identify practical opportunities to use AI across campaign optimisation, audience research, content, SEO/AEO/GEO, reporting and personalisation. Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that improve marketing speed, quality and efficiency. Evaluate emerging marketing technologies that can improve acquisition, lead quality and conversion. Champion an AI-first mindset within the digital marketing function. 8. Agency & Stakeholder Management Manage external agencies, partners, freelancers and specialist vendors where required. Set clear KPIs, SLAs, budgets, reporting standards and performance expectations. Work closely with the Head of Growth, business teams, academic teams, creative/content, admissions and technology/product teams. Ensure timely execution, transparent reporting and accountability across all digital initiatives. 9. Digital Budget Management Support annual and monthly digital marketing planning in alignment with the Head of Growth. Recommend channel-wise budget allocation based on performance, incremental opportunity and business priorities. Forecast acquisition outcomes and proactively identify risks, opportunities and corrective actions. Maintain strong control over digital marketing efficiency and return on investment. Key Performance Indicators Qualified leads and cost per qualified lead Customer acquisition cost (CAC) Digital-attributable admissions and revenue Digital contribution to admissions ROAS / marketing ROI Organic traffic, organic leads and search visibility AI Search / AEO / GEO visibility Website and landing-page conversion rate Lead-to-admission conversion Incremental growth delivered through digital channels Candidate Profile Must Have 7–12 years of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing or digital growth. Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads. Demonstrated experience managing meaningful digital advertising budgets. Strong understanding of performance marketing funnels and lead-generation businesses. Strong analytical capability and comfort working with campaign and funnel data. Working knowledge of GA4, attribution, CRM-based measurement and reporting. Strong understanding of SEO, content marketing and conversion optimisation. Experience managing agencies and/or digital marketing teams. Preferred Experience in EdTech, education, consumer internet, D2C or another high-consideration category. Experience with large-scale lead-generation campaigns. Experience with YouTube performance marketing. Working knowledge of AEO, GEO and AI Search. Experience using AI tools and automation in marketing workflows. Experience building content-led acquisition engines. Experience connecting marketing metrics to admissions, revenue or other business outcomes. The Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a builder and operator who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. They should be performance-led, analytical, commercially minded, curious about AI, comfortable with data and willing to challenge existing approaches through experimentation. What Success Looks Like Success in this role will mean building a disciplined, measurable and scalable digital marketing engine for Deeksha Vedantu — with stronger paid acquisition efficiency, clearer attribution, improved conversion, growing organic discovery and a credible presence across traditional and AI-led search environments.

 About the Role We are looking for a Digital Marketing & Growth professional with 25 years of experience, preferably in the Retort Food, Food, FMCG, Beverage or D2C industry . 
 The role will focus on building the brand digitally, increasing product awareness, generating demand and contributing directly to online and offline sales growth . 
 The ideal candidate should understand both digital marketing and the food consumer and be comfortable using data, content, performance marketing, influencers and AI tools to drive business results. 
 Key Responsibilities Digital & Growth Strategy Develop and execute digital marketing strategies aligned with business and sales targets. Build campaigns to increase brand awareness, product discovery, customer acquisition and repeat purchases . Identify digital opportunities to grow the brand across consumer and trade channels. Study competitors, market trends and consumer behavior. Social Media & Content Manage Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant digital platforms. Run campaigns for awareness, lead generation, website visits and sales. Track and improve CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate and ROAS . Test different audiences, creatives, offers and messaging to improve performance. Allocate marketing budgets based on campaign performance.

 Responsibilities may include: Product listings and digital merchandising Product descriptions and images Online promotions and offers Campaign planning Conversion optimization Monitoring online sales and product performance

Develop campaigns around convenience, taste, quality, nutrition, value and other relevant product propositions. Identify opportunities for recipe-based marketing and meal/occasion-led campaigns. Develop campaigns for festivals, family occasions, parties, quick meals and other relevant consumption occasions. 
 Influencer & Creator Marketing Identify and collaborate with relevant food bloggers, chefs, home chefs, nutrition/food creators and micro-influencers . Plan influencer campaigns and product integrations. Track reach, engagement, traffic and conversions from collaborations. 
 Retail & Trade Support Work with the sales team to create digital campaigns supporting distributors, retailers and modern trade . Develop location-specific campaigns to create demand around available products/outlets. Support product launches and promotions in specific markets. 
 Analytics & Reporting Track digital marketing and sales performance. Use tools such as GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads and Search Console . Prepare weekly/monthly performance reports. Analyse customer behaviour, campaign performance and sales data. Recommend actions based on data and ROI. 
 AI-Enabled Marketing Use AI tools for: Content creation Campaign ideation Consumer research Competitor analysis Ad copy and creatives Content calendars Marketing automation Data analysis Experiment with new AI tools to improve marketing productivity and campaign effectiveness. 
 Required Skills 2–5 years of hands-on experience in Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing. Experience in Retort Food, Food, FMCG, D2C or Consumer Brands preferred. Strong hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads and Google Ads . Good understanding of social media, content and influencer marketing. Experience with e-commerce/quick-commerce is a strong advantage. Knowledge of SEO, GA4 and digital analytics. Strong understanding of customer acquisition and conversion. Good communication and copywriting skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Comfortable working with sales and business teams. Knowledge of Canva and AI marketing tools is an advantage. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile We would especially value candidates who have: Worked with food/FMCG brands . Managed performance marketing campaigns with measurable ROI. Experience with D2C, e-commerce or quick-commerce . Worked with food influencers/creators. Experience launching or scaling consumer products. Demonstrated ability to convert digital activity into leads, customers and sales . 
 Key Performance Indicators Success in this role will be measured through: Digital reach and brand awareness Customer acquisition Website/e-commerce traffic and conversions Online sales growth ROAS and campaign ROI Social media engagement and community growth Influencer campaign performance New customer and repeat customer growth Contribution of digital campaigns to overall sales 
 Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Mass Media, Communications or a related field . Portfolio / proven campaign results will be highly valued. Ideal Candidate A hands-on digital marketer who understands food consumers, knows how to create demand, can run performance campaigns and is commercially focused on generating actual sales — not just likes and followers.

Maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable. Maintain journals, ledgers, cash book, and bank book. Perform regular bank and ledger reconciliations. Review accounting entries and identify discrepancies. Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities. Ensure proper accounting documentation and record maintenance. 
 2. Billing & Invoicing Prepare and process client invoices as per contracts and work orders. Verify supporting documents before raising invoices. Maintain records of invoices, credit notes, debit notes, and receipts. Track outstanding receivables and coordinate for timely collections. Reconcile client/vendor statements and resolve discrepancies.

Manage TDS calculations, deductions, payments, and return-related activities . Maintain proper records for GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements. Track statutory due dates and ensure timely compliance. Coordinate with the CA/Tax Consultant for tax filings, assessments, and other compliance matters. Support statutory and tax audits by providing required documents and information. 
 4. Financial Reconciliation & Reporting Perform bank, vendor, customer, GST, and TDS reconciliations. Identify and resolve outstanding and unreconciled transactions. Prepare periodic accounting and financial reports. Prepare MIS and other reports as required by management. Provide accurate financial information for management decision-making. 
 5. Payroll Knowledge Added Advantage Basic understanding of payroll accounting will be an advantage. Knowledge of salary-related accounting, statutory deductions, PF, ESIC, or Professional Tax will be preferred. Payroll experience is not mandatory , as the primary responsibility of this position is Accounts and Compliance. 
 6. Audit & Documentation Prepare schedules and supporting documents for internal, statutory, and tax audits. Coordinate with auditors, Chartered Accountants, consultants, and internal teams. Maintain proper digital and physical records of accounting and compliance documents. Ensure financial and statutory documents are accurate and readily available.

Strong knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping . Good working knowledge of Tally/Accounting ERP and MS Excel . Knowledge of GST and TDS is required. Good understanding of bank reconciliation, ledger reconciliation, billing, and financial reporting. Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to independently manage accounting activities and statutory deadlines. Good communication and coordination skills. 
 Preferred Candidate Candidates with experience in service-based, manpower/staffing, or contract-based organizations will be preferred. Experience in handling multiple client/vendor accounts will be an advantage. Knowledge of payroll and labour-related compliances is an added advantage, not mandatory . Candidate should be capable of independently handling day-to-day accounting and compliance activities. 
 Key Competencies Accounting | Bookkeeping | GST | TDS | Billing | Bank Reconciliation | Ledger Reconciliation | Tally/ERP | MS Excel | Statutory Compliance | Taxation | Audit Support | MIS Reporting

title: Senior Finance Executive - Finance & Accounts
description:
Job Summary The role will be responsible for managing day-to-day Finance & Accounts activities of the Chennai Centre, including accounting, AP/AR, banking and treasury, payroll accounting, statutory compliances, GST, SOFTEX/RBI requirements, audit support, and related finance operations. The candidate should be hands-on and capable of independently managing assigned finance activities while coordinating with internal teams, banks, consultants, auditors and statutory authorities/service providers. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities Manage day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping and ensure accurate and timely recording of financial transactions. Handle month-end/year-end closing activities, including accruals, depreciation, forex accounting and GL reconciliations. Manage Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable , including invoice processing, payments, collections follow-up and reconciliations. Process domestic and foreign remittances, employee claims, travel advances and settlements. Manage banking and treasury activities , including bank reconciliations, cash-flow monitoring, fund transfers, foreign currency transactions, Fixed Deposits and FIRC follow-up. Handle GST compliances , including input tax credit, RCM, monthly/annual requirements, GST refund claims and coordination for GST assessments/notices. Support TDS, PF, ESI and other applicable statutory compliances and payments , including coordination with consultants. Prepare and submit SOFTEX filings and coordinate with STPI/AD Bank for certification, closure and RBI-related requirements. Handle client invoicing, including generation of e-invoices, accounting of receipts and maintenance/reconciliation of AR. Perform payroll reconciliations and accounting of payroll and employee-related transactions. Coordinate statutory, tax, GST and other audits, including preparation of schedules, reconciliations and supporting documentation. Manage employee timesheet reconciliations and related PMO coordination. Prepare Purchase Orders/Work Orders and support finance-related vendor activities. Maintain finance records and documentation and ensure adherence to company policies and applicable statutory requirements. Coordinate with banks, auditors, tax consultants, LIC, ERP support providers and other external stakeholders as required. Support other Finance & Accounts activities assigned from time to time. Candidate Criteria Qualification CA Inter/CMA Inter preferred along with B.Com/M.Com. 
 Experience 4–6 years of relevant post-qualification/work experience in Finance & Accounts. Preference for candidates from IT/ITES, shared services, service/export-oriented organisations or similar corporate environments . Candidate should have independently handled a meaningful portion of the finance function rather than having experience restricted to only AP, AR or bookkeeping. 
 Essential Experience / Skills Strong hands-on accounting and month-end closing experience. Working knowledge of GST, TDS and other statutory compliances . Experience in AP/AR, banking, payments and reconciliations. Experience in audit coordination and preparation of audit schedules. Good working knowledge of Excel and accounting/ERP systems. Ability to independently coordinate with banks, auditors, consultants and internal stakeholders. Good communication, documentation and follow-up skills. 
 Preferred / Added Advantage Experience with SOFTEX, STPI, FIRC, AD Bank and RBI-related export compliance . Experience in GST refund claims, assessments/notices and annual returns . Exposure to treasury/Fixed Deposit management and foreign remittances. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV/Navision or similar ERP . Experience in payroll reconciliation and statutory payments.

Key Skills: Softex,GST,Statutory Compliance,RBI related export compliance,STPI,TDS,FIRC,Treasury Management

title: Account Development Executive
description:
What You'll Do Avalara is hiring Account Development Representatives (ADRs) to help increase growth by creating conversations with prospective customers, building interest in our products, and generating new pipeline opportunities for our sales team through outbound prospecting. This is more than an entry-level sales role. It is a starting point for individuals who want to build sales skills, perform in a high-expectation environment, and grow their careers over time. At Avalara, we believe in promoting from within. If you want to learn sales fundamentals, put in the work, respond to coaching, and grow your career, then the ADR roles is for you.   What Your Responsibilities Will Be As an ADR, you will build the top of our sales funnel. You will prospect into target accounts, open doors with new partners, create momentum with prospects, and turn outreach into business opportunities. Every day you will initiate conversations with prospective customers, create interest in Avalara solutions, and create new pipeline through outbound outreach. You will qualify opportunities, handle objections, and schedule meetings for the sales team. Research accounts, identify buying signals, and build an understanding of Avalara's products, customers, and market Partner with Account Executives and sales leadership on account strategy, persona targeting, and pipeline creation You will use sales engagement, CRM, AI, and other tools to manage outreach, maintain operating discipline, and support webinars, events, and other demand generation plans when relevant Achieve monthly performance goals tied to activity quality, meetings, pipeline creation, and continuous improvement through feedback   What You’ll Need To Be Successful You're looking for more than just a job—you want to build a meaningful, long-term career. You have 4–10 years of professional experience in sales or other metrics-driven environments. You're motivated to grow your career in sales and enjoy creating opportunities from the ground up. You're resilient, embrace challenges, and are willing to put in the effort every day, learn from rejection, and continuously improve your skills. You thrive on learning, personal growth, new opportunities, and the excitement of outbound prospecting.   Work Location & Schedule This is an onsite role based in Pune. You'll work from the office four days a week, from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST. You will report directly to Sales Manager
