Position Summary The Finance & Accounts Officer will independently handle end-to-end accounting operations across key areas including general accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, taxation, banking, payroll, and MIS . The position is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring statutory compliance, supporting timely financial reporting, and providing reliable financial information to management. Key Responsibilities A. General Accounting Handle day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities. Prepare and post journal entries, payment entries, receipt entries, purchase and sales entries. Maintain general ledger, cash book, bank book and other accounting records. Perform regular ledger scrutiny and account reconciliation. Ensure proper accounting and documentation of all financial transactions. Support month-end and year-end closing activities. B. Accounts Payable Process vendor invoices and verify supporting documents. Ensure proper accounting of purchases, expenses and vendor liabilities. Prepare vendor payment schedules and coordinate for timely payments. Reconcile vendor accounts and resolve discrepancies. Maintain accurate records of outstanding payables. C. Accounts Receivable Prepare and record customer invoices and debit/credit notes. Monitor customer outstanding balances and receivables. Conduct regular customer ledger reconciliation. Follow up for outstanding payments in coordination with the concerned departments. Prepare ageing reports and support collection activities. D. Taxation & Statutory Compliance Assist in ensuring timely compliance with GST, TDS and other applicable statutory requirements . Prepare and maintain data required for GST returns, TDS returns and other statutory filings. Verify tax deductions and ensure correct accounting of statutory liabilities. Reconcile GST input/output records and resolve discrepancies. Maintain proper records and supporting documents for audits and statutory requirements. Coordinate with consultants, auditors and statutory authorities whenever required. E. Banking & Cash Management Handle day-to-day banking transactions. Prepare bank payment instructions and related documentation. Perform regular bank reconciliations. Monitor bank balances and cash flows. Maintain proper records of cheque, online and other banking transactions. Coordinate with banks regarding routine banking matters. F. Payroll & Employee Accounting Coordinate with HR for monthly payroll processing. Verify salary-related data, deductions, advances and reimbursements. Ensure proper accounting of payroll and employee-related expenses. Assist with statutory deductions and payroll-related compliances. Maintain employee advances and settlement records. G. MIS & Financial Reporting Prepare periodic MIS reports for management. Prepare reports relating to receivables, payables, expenses, cash flow and outstanding balances. Provide financial data and analysis as required by management. Support preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements. Identify discrepancies, unusual transactions and variances and bring them to management's attention. H. Audit & Documentation Coordinate with internal, statutory and tax auditors. Provide required schedules, ledgers, vouchers and supporting documents. Maintain proper filing and documentation of financial records. Assist in responding to audit queries and implementing corrective actions. 3. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting or a related field. B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter or equivalent qualification will be preferred. Strong working knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes. Practical knowledge of GST, TDS and basic statutory compliances . Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software such as Tally / ERP systems . Good numerical, analytical and reconciliation skills. 4. Experience 3–7 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts. Experience in handling end-to-end accounting operations independently will be preferred. Candidates with experience in engineering, construction, manufacturing, EPC or project-based organisations will have an added advantage. 5. Key Skills & Competencies Strong accounting and reconciliation skills. Good knowledge of taxation and statutory compliance. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Strong MS Excel and ERP/accounting software skills. Ability to independently manage multiple accounting activities. Good analytical and problem-solving ability. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality of financial information. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet statutory and reporting deadlines. 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Accuracy and completeness of accounting records. Timely closure of monthly accounts. Timely completion of GST/TDS and other applicable compliances. Timely bank, vendor and customer reconciliations. Accuracy of MIS and financial reports. Reduction in outstanding receivables and reconciliation differences. Timely processing of vendor payments and employee-related transactions. Audit compliance and timely resolution of audit queries. 7. Preferred Candidate Profile The preferred candidate should be a self-driven and responsible finance professional capable of independently managing day-to-day accounting operations. The candidate should demonstrate strong practical knowledge of accounting, taxation, reconciliations, banking and MIS, along with a high level of accuracy and ownership. Preference may be given to candidates with experience in Engineering / EPC / Construction / Manufacturing / Project-based companies.

description:

The Fund Accounting Manager will supervise and execute tasks related to maintaining the books and records, reporting, and auditing for a diverse portfolio of investment funds, including open-end funds, closed-end funds, collateralized loan obligation portfolios (CLOs), and risk retention vehicles. This role will ensure compliance with international accounting standards and regulatory requirements, while facilitating communication with internal teams and external service providers, such as third-party administrators, custodians, directors, legal and tax. Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following activities: Portfolio Oversight and Reconciliation Supervise the monthly and quarterly closing process, including pricing, management fee calculations, expense accruals, and portfolio activity reconciliation with custodial and counterparty records. Compliance and Reporting Prepare and review financial statements in compliance with U.S. and U.K. GAAP, IFRS, and investment company accounting rules (when applicable). Coordinate regulatory filings, including AIFMD Annex IV, Form PF, ADV reporting, CRS, and corporate tax reporting. Evaluate fund and client-specific performance metrics (e.g., XIRR and TWR). Audit and Efficiency Execution Coordinate annual financial statement audits and fieldwork with external auditors. Prepare borrowing notices and funding memos for corporate-related activity. Manage fund openings, closings, client drawdowns, and distributions, ensuring smooth communication between stakeholders. Cash and Expense Analysis Support expense analysis, corporate expense reimbursement tracking, waterfall invoice preparation, and wire payment execution. Oversee corporate actions related to delayed compensation, cost of carry, amendment fees, and PIK interest amongst others. Support and Collaboration Monitor work performed by third-party administrators and custodians, ensuring accuracy and quality control. Respond to ad-hoc queries from client services and internal teams and implement setups for new funds and CLOs across accounting, marketing, performance, and trading systems. Experience Required Minimum 2-6 years relevant accounting or audit experience within Big Four public accounting or a mix of public accounting and investment management industry experience; Strong knowledge of reconciliation and account analysis; Excellent understanding of accounting and the ability to apply relevant investment company accounting rules; Solid analytical skills and ability to understand and resolve complex problems; Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word; Experience with Geneva and/or Geneva World Investor accounting systems is a plus; Experience with PowerBI, Alteryx, or other data analytical tools is a plus; Working knowledge of CLOs and Risk Retention Vehicles a plus, including CLO lifecycle, including all aspects of the Warehouse Phase, Ramping of Portfolio, Pricing, Close, Drawdowns, Repayments, Day One S110 Test, 1st Loss Equity Tranche, Waterfall Schedule, Priority of Payments, Resets and Refinancing, Management and Incentive Fees, Par and Cash, Aggregate Principal/Collateral Balance Calculations Education Bachelor's degree is required, preferred in Accounting or Finance CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent qualification is a plus

Maintain deep understanding of the IFRS16 process performance landscape, identifying quality gaps and improvement opportunities. Maintain the measures, controls and reporting required for a strong E2E IFRS16 compliance framework across markets.

Excellent communication abilities to articulate accounting judgement clearly and transparently. Strong coordination, analytical problem-solving and presentation capabilities. Adaptable, innovative and highly collaborative mindset with strong business prioritisation awareness.

title: Group Account Manager - Events & Exhibitions
description:
Group Account Manager 
 Job Summary We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Group Account Manager to manage key client accounts and lead the execution of BTL marketing campaigns, events, activations, exhibitions, and brand initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing client relationships, coordinating with internal and external teams, driving account growth, and ensuring seamless execution of projects while meeting client expectations and business objectives. The candidate should have strong experience in client servicing, brand activations, events, exhibitions, and experiential marketing , along with the ability to manage multiple accounts and projects simultaneously. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Account & Client Management Manage a portfolio of key client accounts and act as the primary point of contact. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients and key stakeholders. Understand client briefs, business objectives, brand requirements, and project expectations. Ensure timely communication, follow-ups, approvals, and delivery across all accounts. Proactively identify client requirements and provide relevant solutions. Handle client escalations and ensure timely resolution of issues. 
 2. Campaign & Event Management Lead the planning and execution of BTL campaigns, events, activations, exhibitions, and brand experiences. Develop campaign approaches and execution plans in line with client objectives. Coordinate with creative, production, operations, and other internal teams for smooth project execution. Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines, quality standards, and client expectations. Be actively involved in pre-event planning, on-ground execution, and post-event closure. Conduct post-project reviews and identify areas for improvement. 
 3. Business Development & Account Growth Identify opportunities for growth within existing accounts. Explore upselling and cross-selling opportunities across the agency's services. Support new business pitches, proposals, presentations, and client meetings. Develop a strong understanding of client businesses to identify potential opportunities. Contribute towards revenue growth and expansion of assigned accounts. 
 4. Team & Internal Coordination Lead and coordinate account servicing teams working across assigned accounts. Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of deliverables. Work closely with creative, production, operations, procurement, and finance teams. Ensure clear communication of client briefs and expectations to internal teams. Review team deliverables and provide necessary guidance and feedback. Support junior team members in managing client requirements and projects. 
 5. Creative & Strategic Collaboration Work closely with creative and strategy teams to develop relevant campaign concepts and solutions. Participate in brainstorming sessions, client presentations, and pitch discussions. Ensure creative solutions are aligned with brand guidelines and campaign objectives. Provide strategic inputs based on client requirements, market understanding, and campaign objectives. 
 6. Project & Operations Management Manage multiple projects simultaneously from briefing to execution and closure. Prepare and track project timelines, deliverables, approvals, and dependencies. Monitor project progress and proactively identify potential delays or challenges. Coordinate with vendors and external partners wherever required. Ensure smooth execution while maintaining quality and client expectations. 
 7. Budget & Commercial Management Support preparation and management of project budgets and estimates. Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to ensure cost-effective execution. Monitor project costs and ensure adherence to approved budgets. Support commercial negotiations with vendors and service partners. Ensure projects are executed efficiently without compromising quality. 
 8. Reporting & Documentation Prepare regular account updates, project status reports, presentations, and other client communication. Maintain proper documentation of briefs, approvals, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables. Track account activities and provide regular updates to senior management. Maintain accurate records of ongoing and completed projects. 
 9. Client Retention & Relationship Growth Understand client expectations and proactively address concerns. Maintain regular engagement with key client stakeholders. Identify opportunities to strengthen relationships and increase account engagement. Ensure a high level of client satisfaction across projects. Build trust with clients through consistent communication, ownership, and quality delivery. 
 10. Overall Ownership Take complete ownership of assigned accounts and projects. Ensure timely, high-quality, and commercially effective delivery. Demonstrate strong accountability and proactive problem-solving. Contribute to the overall growth, profitability, and reputation of the agency. Take greater responsibility for client relationships, team performance, and project outcomes. 
 Qualifications & Skills 3-4 years of relevant experience in BTL, events, activations, exhibitions, experiential marketing, or advertising agencies . Strong experience in client servicing and account management. Good understanding of brand activations, events, exhibitions, and experiential campaigns.

title: Front Office Executive cum Admin Coordinator & Travel Desk
description:
About the Role We are looking for a highly organized, professional, and customer-focused Front Office Executive cum Admin Coordinator & Travel Desk to manage the front office operations while supporting day-to-day administrative activities and employee travel requirements. The ideal candidate will be the first point of contact for visitors, employees, and external stakeholders. This role requires excellent communication skills, strong coordination abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities efficiently. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Front Office & Reception Management Manage the front desk and ensure a professional and welcoming experience for all visitors and employees. Greet visitors, candidates, clients, and other stakeholders and direct them to the appropriate person or department. Handle incoming calls, emails, and general enquiries professionally. Maintain visitor records and ensure adherence to company security and visitor management procedures. Coordinate meeting room bookings and ensure meeting rooms are well maintained and ready for use. Manage incoming and outgoing couriers, parcels, and official correspondence. Maintain the reception and front office area in a professional and presentable manner. Support employee and candidate coordination whenever required. 
 2. Administration Coordination Coordinate day-to-day administrative activities across the office. Work closely with internal teams and external vendors for various administrative requirements. Coordinate with vendors for office supplies, housekeeping, security, maintenance, transport, and other facility-related services. Maintain records of office assets, consumables, and administrative inventory. Ensure timely availability of office stationery and other required supplies. Support invoice collection, vendor documentation, and coordination with the Finance team for payments. Track and follow up on administrative requests and ensure timely resolution. Assist in organizing internal meetings, employee engagement activities, and company events. Support onboarding arrangements for new employees, including workstation and administrative requirements. Maintain relevant administrative reports, trackers, and documentation. 
 3. Travel Desk Management Manage end-to-end travel arrangements for employees and business visitors. Coordinate domestic and international travel requirements, including: Flight bookings Hotel reservations Airport transfers Local transportation Other travel-related arrangements Coordinate with approved travel agencies and vendors. Ensure travel bookings are made in line with company policies and approved budgets. Maintain proper travel records, booking confirmations, and expense-related documentation. Handle travel changes, cancellations, and emergency travel requirements efficiently. Coordinate travel itineraries and share complete travel details with employees. Maintain a travel tracker and prepare periodic reports on travel requirements and expenses. Ensure smooth coordination between employees, travel vendors, Finance, and Administration teams. 
 4. Vendor & Facility Coordination Act as a point of contact for administrative and facility-related vendors. Coordinate with vendors for timely delivery of services. Maintain vendor contact details, agreements, and service-related documentation. Follow up on maintenance issues and ensure timely resolution. Assist in monitoring service quality and escalating concerns when required. Support cost optimization initiatives related to administration and travel. 
 Skills & Competencies Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and customer service skills. Professional personality and presentation. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities. Good coordination and follow-up skills. Ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook . Experience in travel coordination and vendor management will be an advantage. 
 Experience Required 14 years of relevant experience in: Front Office / Reception Administration Coordination Travel Desk Executive Assistance or Office Coordination Candidates with experience in a corporate environment will be preferred. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is: Professional and presentable. Highly organized and proactive. Comfortable interacting with employees, senior management, clients, and visitors. Able to manage front office responsibilities along with administrative coordination. Experienced in handling travel bookings and vendor coordination. Comfortable working independently and managing multiple tasks simultaneously. 
 Why Join Us? This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain exposure across Front Office Operations, Administration, Vendor Management, Employee Coordination, and Corporate Travel Management while working in a dynamic and growing organization. Join us and become an important part of creating a smooth, professional, and welcoming workplace experience for everyone.

title: Wellness Coordinator
description:
Department: Wellness / Preventive Healthcare
 Designation: Wellness Coordinator
 Reporting To: Centre Manager / Operations Manager / Wellness Head
 Location: Uniscans & Labs / Diagnostic Centre
 Employment Type: Full-Time 1. Job Summary The Wellness Coordinator is responsible for coordinating preventive health and wellness services, supporting patients throughout their wellness journey, coordinating health check-up packages, and ensuring a smooth and positive patient experience. The role involves patient communication, appointment coordination, package explanation, follow-ups, health camp coordination, and collaboration with doctors and internal departments. 2. Key Responsibilities Patient Coordination & Counselling Welcome and assist patients visiting for wellness and preventive health services. Understand patient requirements and guide them toward appropriate wellness packages as per approved offerings. Explain health check-up packages, procedures, inclusions, preparation requirements, and timelines. Coordinate patient appointments and ensure smooth movement between departments. Address patient queries professionally and escalate clinical queries to the appropriate medical professional. Maintain patient confidentiality and provide a positive service experience. Health Check-Up Package Coordination Coordinate executive health check-ups, preventive health packages, corporate wellness packages, and other wellness programs. Ensure all investigations included in a package are completed. Coordinate with laboratory, radiology, cardiology, and other departments. Track pending investigations and ensure timely completion. Coordinate the preparation and delivery of health check-up reports. Appointment & Follow-Up Management Schedule and confirm appointments for wellness services. Make reminder calls/messages to patients regarding appointments and required preparation. Follow up with patients regarding pending investigations or reports. Maintain records of appointments, follow-ups, conversions, and patient feedback. Assist in rescheduling appointments when required. Corporate Wellness & Health Camps Coordinate corporate health check-up programs and wellness initiatives. Assist in organizing health camps, awareness programs, screening programs, and wellness events. Coordinate with corporate clients, HR teams, doctors, technicians, and internal departments. Ensure required manpower, equipment, consumables, and documentation are arranged before health camps. Maintain participant records and coordinate report distribution. Patient Experience Ensure patients receive timely and courteous assistance throughout their visit. Monitor waiting time and coordinate with relevant departments to minimize delays. Collect patient feedback and communicate recurring concerns to management. Assist in resolving service-related issues promptly. Maintain a professional and patient-friendly environment. Administrative Responsibilities Maintain daily wellness programme records and MIS reports. Track package bookings, completed check-ups, pending services, and report status. Prepare daily/weekly/monthly performance reports as required. Maintain proper documentation related to wellness activities. Coordinate billing and payment-related requirements with the accounts/reception team. Coordination with Internal Teams Work closely with doctors, nurses, laboratory staff, radiology staff, reception, billing, marketing, and operations teams. Ensure smooth communication between patients and various departments. Escalate operational or patient-related concerns to the Centre Manager. Support management in implementing new wellness initiatives and patient engagement programs. 3. Wellness Program Promotion Support the promotion of approved preventive health check-up packages. Explain package benefits and services accurately without making unauthorized medical claims. Coordinate with the marketing/corporate team for wellness campaigns. Support patient conversion and retention initiatives. Maintain professional communication with existing and prospective patients. 4. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Management, Hospital Administration, Life Sciences, Nursing, Allied Health Sciences, or any relevant discipline . Candidates with healthcare/customer-service experience will be preferred. 5. Experience 13 years of experience in a hospital, diagnostic centre, wellness centre, healthcare organization, or customer-care role preferred. Freshers with strong communication and coordination skills may also be considered. 6. Required Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong patient-handling and interpersonal skills. Good coordination and follow-up abilities. Customer-service orientation. Basic knowledge of healthcare services and diagnostic investigations. Good computer and MS Office skills. Ability to maintain accurate records and MIS reports. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Ability to handle multiple patients and activities simultaneously. Professional and empathetic approach. 7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Patient satisfaction and feedback. Number of wellness packages coordinated. Appointment conversion and attendance rate. Timely completion of wellness packages. Follow-up effectiveness. Health camp and corporate wellness programme coordination. Reduction in patient waiting time. Accuracy of documentation and MIS reporting. Customer retention and repeat wellness visits. 8. Working Conditions Full-time position in a healthcare/diagnostic environment. May require participation in health camps, corporate wellness programmes, and weekend activities. May require flexible working hours based on patient and programme requirements. Strict adherence to organizational policies, patient confidentiality, and healthcare service standards is required.

description:
Job Description 
 1. Export & Import Logistics Operations Manage end-to-end export and import logistics for pharmaceutical formulations through Air and Sea modes. Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, and Custom House Agents (CHA) for timely shipment execution. Plan dispatch schedules based on production plans, customer requirements, and market demand. Ensure smooth movement of consignments while meeting delivery commitments. 2. Customs Documentation & Compliance Prepare, verify, and maintain export/import documentation including Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Shipping Bill, Bill of Lading (BL), Air Waybill (AWB), Certificate of Origin (COO), SDF, ARE-1, and other statutory documents. Coordinate customs clearance activities with CHA and regulatory authorities. Ensure compliance with DGFT, Customs, CDSCO, ADC, and other applicable regulations. 3. Regulatory & Pharma Compliance Manage Assistant Drug Controller (ADC) clearance for pharmaceutical exports and imports. Ensure compliance with GMP, GDP, temperature-controlled shipments, dangerous goods regulations, and international pharmaceutical logistics standards. Verify that shipments meet all quality, regulatory, and customer documentation requirements. 4. Shipment Planning & Tracking Schedule shipments as per customer purchase orders, tender timelines, and production availability. Track shipments from dispatch to final delivery and provide regular status updates to stakeholders. Maintain shipment records for audits, statutory compliance, and internal reference. 5. Freight Management & Cost Optimization Negotiate freight rates and service agreements with logistics partners. Monitor freight costs and identify opportunities for logistics optimization. Verify freight invoices and resolve billing discrepancies with vendors. 6. Export Incentives & EXIM Management Handle Advance Authorization, EPCG, Duty Drawback, RoDTEP, and other export incentive schemes. Coordinate with DGFT, Finance, and external consultants for timely filing and claim processing. Maintain documentation related to export benefits and regulatory compliance. 7. Internal Coordination & Reporting Collaborate with Production, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Finance, and Warehouse teams to ensure smooth dispatch operations. Prepare and present MIS reports covering shipment status, customs clearance, freight costs, export performance, and incentive claims. Ensure departmental SOPs are implemented, reviewed, and updated periodically. Key Competency Required:

 5+ years experience in SAP PI/PO/CPI project implementations, rollouts, and support across diverse industries including Tax, HR, Manufacturing etc. Core Skills Expert in SAP Process Orchestration (PO) – ESR, Integration Directory, BPM. Good hands on exp. in API Management . Strong integration technology knowledge: XML, SOAP, REST, JDBC, JMS, RFC. Proficient with enterprise integration patterns (synchronous/asynchronous, point-to-point, publish/subscribe). Skilled in data mapping, transformation (XML, JSON, IDoc, flat files), and custom Java development for adapters and mappings. Deep understanding of SAP systems and integration (ECC, S/4HANA, CRM), SAP NetWeaver, ESB concepts. Security (SSL/TLS, SFTP, user authentication), monitoring, troubleshooting (incl. third-party tools). Strong skills in SAP PO/ABAP design and development. Experience in connecting PO / CPI to both SAP and multiple non-SAP systems. Should have possessed standard adapter module beans and should perform migration activities. Strong experience in Graphical Mapping with UDF knowledge and have good unit Testing and UAT exposure Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and continuous SAP learning. Responsibilities Design, develop, and configure integration solutions and interfaces between SAP and non-SAP systems. Conduct functional/non-functional testing, deployment, version management, and support. Monitor and troubleshoot integration scenarios. Working with ABAP proxy, IDOC's, Function Modules/ BAPI, BADI, Customer-exits, ALE Configuring and developing interfaces in the SAP PO 7.5 and CPI instance. Working with SAP IDOC processing and monitoring services including the SAP PO IDOC sender and receiver adapters to transform messages from SAP IDOC to XML format. Develop, test, debug, implement, maintain and document interfaces using SAP Proxy, IDOC, REST technologies. Produce and maintain solution documentation and provide knowledge transfer/training. Collaborate with stakeholders to capture requirements and deliver value-aligned solutions. Business & Consulting Skills In-depth understanding of business processes (finance, supply chain, HR, sales, procurement). Requirements gathering, process mapping/optimization, change management. Knowledge of multiple SAP modules (ERP, S/4HANA, CRM, SCM, HCM) and SAP best practices. Experience with BI, analytics, and project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). Leadership & Supervision Integration architecture design, strategy, and team leadership. Project/risk management, performance monitoring, quality assurance. Change management, governance/compliance, vendor/stakeholder management. Fosters continuous improvement and team development. General Skills Strong analytical, problem-solving, and time management abilities. Clear communicator and collaborator. Customer-focused, adaptable, and committed to ongoing learning and quality

Key Skills: SAP CPI,SAP PI PO,API Management,ECC,SAP Process Orchestration,SAP Integration,SAP S HANA,SAP PI
